decisions: Fair line is inverse integer-PMF location minimizing difference from the power-devigged home/Over non-push probability. Among equally close probabilities, choose nearest posted center; remaining ties midpoint. No residual smoothing.

Pinnacle anchor is equal weight between the other execution books median and Pinnacle location. With only one component, use that component. No independent component yields MISSED NO_QUOTES; never self-reference.
The distribution center is frozen existing integer rounding. Full and each book-specific leave-one-out center and provenance are stored.
EV = unconditional win probability * net payout - unconditional loss probability, push zero. fair_probability is labeled conditional_non_push.
Exact EV ties draw side uniformly first, then book uniformly, from sorted candidates with SHA256(game_id|version) and market-separated RNG streams.
Freeze worker starts in the final minute preceding T75, verifies actual completion by cutoff, and records actual timestamp. Capture only first 60 seconds of T80; no retries or backfill.

No global provider snapshot timestamp is offered by live Odds API: store null explicitly; retain provider HTTP response time separately and every bookmaker/market update timestamp. Never fabricate a snapshot timestamp.

Reserve three credits before each dispatch under an exclusive ledger lock. Settle only authoritative 0..3 credit headers. Uncertain requests retain reservation. 20 unresolved reservations exhaust 60 credits; a 61st attempt is refused, not authorized.

Shadows freeze 2025 evaluation-row coefficients from harvest two/three (trained through 2024). Elo adjusts each independent market location by c*(Elo margin - market margin). Weather uses wind and dome coefficients only, no refit or other predictors.

ANY/A uses published prior-week player metrics with untuned league prior for a depth-chart starter lacking history; known inactive starter or unavailable/lagging QB data means shadow unavailable, never zero-filled. Inactives have no promoted counterfactual coefficient.

Inactives public source probe found no dedicated ESPN inactives collection on either Week 1 summary. Scheduled T85 attempt accepts only that explicit collection. Injuries/Out reports are never treated as complete inactives; missing or stale depth/list remains unknown.

Public ingestion prepares label-free schedule and state DTOs separately. Lock worker has no final feed. Scorer consumes locked decision DTO and separate nflverse final/close feed; it does not follow capture paths.

CLV probability = closing distribution fair non-push probability at locked line minus locked fair probability. CLV cents = initial fair American price cents minus closing fair American price cents. Reference is nflverse_close, distinct from old executed-book CLV.
Final feed requires both scores, agreeing result/total fields, and both close lines. First grade is immutable; later source corrections cannot silently overwrite it.
T75 paper wind rule is a separately named cutoff version retaining the 30-pick/positive CLV gate; T60 entries are not pooled. No money is placed by these model-pick records.
First rehearsal config.json and synthetic artifacts remain unchanged. runtime-config.json pins final deployment after report/operational completion; no active model-pick decision logic changed.

Old launchd label retained for continuity, but its executable is now model_pick_runner.py. New daily job checks hourly and completes once per UTC date; T65 worker is no longer scheduled. Daily Git autosave remains installed.
Atomic create-only artifacts publish via hard link after fsync. Staging links are retained locally and ignored; no files deleted.
limitations: Mac sleep can still miss captures. Cloud host and cross-host lock remain blocked by DigitalOcean account/API access; see work/cloud-scheduler-v1/experiment.json.

ESPN inactives collection unavailable in current probes; unknowns are expected until a reliable list is actually returned.
nflverse closing lines are retrospective consensus reference, not guaranteed executed-book closing quotes. Reports label the distinction.
